_what: Cross-language replication of the four output contracts (English prompt, same pool)

counting_rules.abstention: `abstain is True` (the contract's own refusal token)
counting_rules.double_annotation: a row that is both `pred == 0` and `abstain is True`; the inclusive reading counts it as an answered zero and the exclusive reading does not, and both are printed where the case arises
counting_rules.rows_counted: only rows with http == 200; other rows enter neither numerator nor denominator
counting_rules.unparseable: `parse_ok is False`, reported in its own column and never merged into abstention

replication_definition: A family counts as replicated when its outlet effect (no_name0_no_exit -> no_name0_exit) and its naming effect at both outlet levels (no_name0 -> name0, without and with the outlet) point the same way (same sign) in both prompt languages. The count is three of four families. The fourth, q32fp8, is at the ceiling in both languages and its outlet-effect sign changes there.
